mobileNav.heading: Mobile navigation
mobileNav.label: Bottom tab bar
mobileNav.description: Show a fixed tab bar at the bottom of the screen on mobile. Turn off to use the classic hamburger menu instead. Has no effect on wide screens.

theme.heading: App Theme
theme.description: Master a Pokémon to unlock it as an app colour theme.

languages.label: Languages
languages.description: Show Pokémon names in Japanese, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese.

masteryThreshold.label: Mastery threshold
masteryThreshold.description: Cards with this many consecutive correct reviews count as mastered.

recallTarget.label: Recall target ({percent}%)
recallTarget.description: Lower means fewer reviews but you will forget more cards. Higher means more reviews but better retention. Default 90%.

playCryOnReveal.label: Play cry on reveal
playCryOnReveal.description: Plays the Pokémon's cry once when you reveal a name or evolution card.

speakNameOnReveal.label: Speak name on reveal
speakNameOnReveal.description: Reads the Pokémon's name aloud using your device's text-to-speech engine when you reveal a card.

backup.heading: Backup
backup.exportDescription: Downloads a JSON backup of all your card progress and settings.
backup.importDescription: Restore from a previously exported backup. Replaces current progress after confirmation.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: Used for daily review limits and streak roll-overs. Auto-detected on first load.

dateFormat.label: Date format
dateFormat.description: Controls how dates are shown throughout the app.

dangerZone.heading: Danger zone
dangerZone.resetDescriptionCloud: Permanently deletes your review history and cloud data.
dangerZone.deleteDescription: Permanently erases your account, cloud data, and sign-in identity. This cannot be undone.

developer.heading: Developer
developer.description: QA shortcuts. While any flag here is on, sync to the cloud is paused so QA state cannot leak into your real data.

pretendAllMastered.label: Pretend all Pokémon are mastered
pretendAllMastered.description: Renders every species as mastered across the Pokédex, detail pages, Pasture, Stats, and the theme picker.

practice.title: Poké Memory - Learn every Pokémon
practice.description: Free spaced-repetition flashcards for learning all 1025 Pokémon names and evolutions. No sign-up required.

pokedex.title: Pokédex
pokedex.description: Browse all 1025 Pokémon. Filter by generation, type, or mastery status.

pasture.title: Pasture
pasture.description: Pokémon you have mastered live here.
pasture.empty: Your pasture is empty. Master some Pokémon to see them here.
